revision: Last-dose reference; 20s minimum; rising blocks, plateau/fall permits replenishment below49500.
status: Uploaded with verification; physical regulation not yet validated. Exploratory simulations contain failures.
formula: previous_ms * (0.5 * deficit / previous_net_peak_rise), increase limited to10%; if net rise<50ppm, calculate10% increase; unknown-response duration additionally bounded.
scope: Transport, mixing, gains and relative volumes remain hypothetical; no claim that all scenarios pass. Named observed scenarios use measured valve-response points but assumed chamber parameters. Two-chamber sensor peaks differ from main chamber peaks.

chamber_model.notes: Transport, dispersion and chamber exchange are separate assumptions. Gas balance and tank limiting cases checked. Firmware timing still includes its legacy cycle counter.

one.model: Real C++ dose selection, response timing and model header. Hypothetical chamber: transport lag + exponential mixing + constant loss; linear/dead-time and nonlinear valve plants. Nonlinear plant includes measured 207/320ms responses not used as dose presets. 30s door pause; sensor failure; valve contact outage then restoration. This is not a physical validation.
